_readme: Hub assistant settings (Mark, 3 Nov 2026) - the home-page chat box and the Lens Finder box share them. Copy to config/lenschat.json (git-ignored). It runs only when enabled is true AND an API key is present (environment CEC_LENSCHAT_API_KEY, or key_file - keep that file OUTSIDE every repo). Spend: cap_aud per Sydney calendar month, enforced by the ledger file (outside every repo; create once with: python -m hub.lenschat init-ledger; an old trial ledger is converted in place on first read, spend carried forward). trial_days 0 = no end date. Mark-only: requests from the server itself, or from the device addresses in allow_ips. Which tools run is set in config/assistant.json (switch off / narrow only).
